eyebrow: Why movers quietly cause access creep
code:
AP Clerk -> moves to -> AR Clerk

New role granted:   AR module access (fast - blocks work)
Old role removed:   AP module access (slow - blocks nothing)

Result after 3 moves: AP + AR + 2 prior roles, all still active
caption: Granting access is urgent. Removing it isn't - so it often just doesn't happen.
